It needs to operate continuously for days or even weeks, while also gaining access to enterprise assets and operating capital. Partiendo de esta idea, Bottleneck Labs llevó a cabo recientemente un experimento muy cercano a un entorno empresarial real: cuando un agente de IA de vanguardia dispone de todas las herramientas que posee una empresa real, ver si es capaz de generar resultados comerciales reales.

Recently, IDC released its "IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Foundation Model Software 2026 Vendor Assessment" report. A total of 11 vendors worldwide were listed, and Alibaba Cloud was selected into the "Leaders" quadrant based on its Qwen model family and Qwen AI platform. It was the only Chinese vendor in this quadrant, alongside Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Amazon in the top tier.

IDC noted that 2026 has entered an era of multi-model, multi-agent, multimodal, and autonomous execution. Unlike single-dimension model benchmarks, this assessment examined the comprehensive competitiveness of "model capability plus service capability."

At the model layer, IDC pointed out that the Qwen large model family adopts a unified MoE architecture and pretraining paradigm, offering a full range of sizes from lightweight to Max scale, with support for reasoning, coding, and multilingual capabilities. It has launched dozens of self-developed models in text generation, reasoning, multimodal understanding, multimodal generation, and professional task domains.

At the model service layer, IDC stated that Alibaba Cloud provides a rich array of large language models, multimodal models, and scenario-optimized models, accompanied by a complete toolchain for data processing, fine-tuning, evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and application building and deployment.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, IDC publicó el informe «IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Foundation Model Software 2026 Vendor Assessment» (Evaluación de proveedores de software de modelos fundacionales a nivel mundial). En total, 11 proveedores a nivel mundial aparecen en la lista. Alibaba Cloud, gracias a la familia de modelos Qwen y a la plataforma de IA Qwen, ha sido seleccionada en el cuadrante de «Líderes (Leaders)», siendo la única empresa china en entrar en este cuadrante, junto a Google, Anthropic, OpenAI y Amazon en el primer escalón. items.raw_excerpt: 本周，MiniMax 正式开源新一代通用多模态生成模型 MiniMax H3，在 Artificial Analysis 视频编辑评测榜、Arena 图生视频排行榜中均位列全球第一，并获得 Stable Diffusion 创始人 Emad Mostaque、硅谷投资机构 a16z 合伙人 Justine Moore 等业内知名人士点赞。 目前，在开源社区 Hugging Face 上，MiniMax H3 热度已上升至第一名，超过 DeepSeek V4 Flash。 H3 在模型评测和开发者社区中的表现，反映出大模型竞争正逐步由单纯模型能力比拼转向生态能力竞争。对于开源模型而言，芯片适配、推理框架支持、开发者社区接入以及应用落地速度，正成为衡量其生态成熟度的重要指标。H3 开源 24 小时内即获超百家国内外合作伙伴首日适配及接入。从 DeepSeek 到 MiniMax H3，中国模型公司的开源范围正在从语言模型拓展到视频模型，H3 已成为中国开源 AI 向多模态领域延伸的标志性事件。 近期，杰富瑞重申 MiniMax 买入评级，目标价 1118 港元。杰富瑞最新研报显示，MiniMax H3 的推出进一步巩固 MiniMax 在 AI 视频生成领域的竞争地位，其成本优势将有助于拓展企业客户及加速商业化落地。花旗最新研报显示，MiniMax H3 具备商用级内容生成能力，对 MiniMax 维持买入评级。截至 5 日收盘时，MiniMax 涨幅超 10%。

excerpt_i18n.zh: 本周，MiniMax 正式开源新一代通用多模态生成模型 MiniMax H3，在 Artificial Analysis 视频编辑评测榜、Arena 图生视频排行榜中均位列全球第一，并获得 Stable Diffusion 创始人 Emad Mostaque、硅谷投资机构 a16z 合伙人 Justine Moore 等业内知名人士点赞。 目前，在开源社区 Hugging Face 上，MiniMax H3 热度已上升至第一名，超过 DeepSeek V4 Flash。 H3 在模型评测和开发者社区中的表现，反映出大模型竞争正逐步由单纯模型能力比拼转向生态能力竞争。对于开源模型而言，芯片适配、推理框架支持、开发者社区接入以及应用落地速度，正成为衡量其生态成熟度的重要指标。H3 开源 24 小时内即获超百家国内外合作伙伴首日适配及接入。从 DeepSeek 到 MiniMax H3，中国模型公司的开源范围正在从语言模型拓展到视频模型，H3 已成为中国开源 AI 向多模态领域延伸的标志性事件。 近期，杰富瑞重申 MiniMax 买入评级，目标价 1118 港元。杰富瑞最新研报显示，MiniMax H3 的推出进一步巩固 MiniMax 在 AI 视频生成领域的竞争地位，其成本优势将有助于拓展企业客户及加速商业化落地。花旗最新研报显示，MiniMax H3 具备商用级内容生成能力，对 MiniMax 维持买入评级。截至 5 日收盘时，MiniMax 涨幅超 10%。
excerpt_i18n.en: This week, MiniMax officially open-sourced its next-generation general multimodal generation model, MiniMax H3, which ranks first globally on the Artificial Analysis video editing leaderboard and the Arena image-to-video leaderboard. It has also been praised by industry figures such as Stable Diffusion founder Emad Mostaque and a16z partner Justine Moore. On the open-source community Hugging Face, MiniMax H3 has risen to the top spot, surpassing DeepSeek V4 Flash. The performance of H3 in model evaluation and the developer community reflects that competition in large models is gradually shifting from sheer model capability to ecosystem capability. For open-source models, chip adaptation, inference framework support, developer community integration, and speed of application deployment are becoming key indicators of ecosystem maturity. Within 24 hours of open-sourcing, H3 had already been adapted and integrated by over 100 domestic and international partners. From DeepSeek to MiniMax H3, Chinese model companies are expanding their open-source scope from language models to video models, and H3 has become a landmark event in the extension of China's open-source AI into the multimodal domain. items.title: Taming Outlier Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
items.raw_excerpt: We study outlier tokens in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation. Prior work has shown that Vision Transformers (ViTs) can produce a small number of high-norm tokens that attract disproportionate attention while carrying limited local information, but their role in generative models remains underexplored. We show that this phenomenon appears in both the encoder and denoiser of modern Representation Autoencoder (RAE)-DiT pipelines: pretrained ViT encoders can produce outlier representations, and DiTs themselves can develop internal outlier tokens, especially in intermediate layers…
